entries.impact: Several bound error shapes share one wire error code, so a query or awsQueryCompatible client resolves that code to only one of them. The QueryErrorCode validation event is suppressed.

C2J metadata properties with no standard trait (for example globalEndpoint, checksumFormat, resultWrapped, or a targetPrefix that cannot be the service shape name) are only available from this marker, which holds just those properties.
The declared order and duplicates of operation errors. Operation errors are also emitted, so only the order and duplicates are marker-only.
The verbatim method, requestUri and responseCode of an operation with no @http trait (RPC protocols ignore HTTP bindings).
A paginator without an input_token cannot be expressed with @paginated. The operation gets no @paginated trait, so no paginator is generated from standard traits.
A paginator without an output_token cannot be expressed with @paginated. The operation gets no @paginated trait, so no paginator is generated from standard traits.
@paginated has one items member, so a paginator with several result keys gets no items and no per-result-key iterables are generated from standard traits.
The declaration order of required members. @required is also emitted, so only the order is marker-only.
The SDK-synthesized shape flag is only available from this marker.
Smithy waiters cannot express this acceptor (for example a status other than 200, or a numeric expected value). The waiter is not converted, so it is not generated from standard traits.
Smithy waiters bound waiting by maxWaitTime, not by attempt count. A waiter generated from standard traits does not get the C2J maxAttempts.
